title: SE implementation scratchpad - Silver Peak Capital
content:
2026-02-20 / running notes (working scratchpad)

Context: Silver Peak Capital (SPC) - pilot for Private deployment (VPC) + Dedicated GPU for quantized MPT-30B-like model. Goal: launch PoC for research desktop + secure inference for internal portfolio tools. Customer asked for: VPC peering, bring-your-own-KMS, audit logs, model pin (v1.2-quant), and autoscale-burst to handle end-of-day batch jobs.

Today
- standup w/ Tom (15m) recap: confirmed VPC CIDR
- call w/ SPC infra lead (45m): covered peering, CIDR overlaps, egress rules, KMS keys
- prepare rollout checklist for canary to 10%

Top-level action items
- A1: Finalize VPC CIDR & peering config (owner: SPC infra / contact: ajay@spc.com) -> need explicit non-overlap. My task: produce suggested CIDR map + terraform snippet (due 2026-02-24).
- A2: KMS integration: SPC wants customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) + Redwood to register key ARN. Need key policy template. Owner: Priya (SE). PR: platform-config/#412 references sample. Due 2026-02-26.
- A3: Model pin and quant profile: Pin to mpt-30b-v1.2-quant (int8) for predictable cost. Validate quality regression test on 5 eval prompts (I will run local eval harness). Owner: Aisha. Due 2026-02-28.
- A4: Autoscale policy for dedicated pool: baseline 2 gpus, scale to 8 for bursts (90th% window = 30s latency SLO). Need policy YAML and cost estimate. Owner: Tom. Due 2026-03-03.
- A5: Canary rollouts: start at 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automated rollback on quality/regression alerts. Add fallback to hosted smaller model for latency spikes. Owner: SE team. Draft rollout in Confluence.

Config notes (rough)
- VPC peering: allow inbound on 10.40.0.0/16 -> redwood-managed subnet 10.80.0.0/18; recommend SPC use 10.40.0.0/16 (no overlap with their corp 10.0.0.0/8? confirm).
- Security groups: allow TCP 8443 from SPC CIDR, deny 0.0.0.0/0. Add logging on ALB.
- KMS: SPC will create key with alias: alias/spc-redwood-inference; need to add Redwood service principal (arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/inference-service) to key policy. Draft policy snippet in linked PR.
- Model config:
  - model_id: mpt-30b-v1.2-quant
  - max_seq_len: 2048
  - kv-cache: enabled
  - batcher: dynamic, prefer latency-first (max-batch 16, max-latency-ms 50)
  - quant_profile: int8-llm-adapt (baseline)

Quick commands / snippets (for later)
- terraform snippet (VPC peering):
  terraform aws_vpc_peering_connection ... (placeholder)
- register key: rcli kms register --arn arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/xxxxxxxx --tenant spc
- pin model: rcli model pin --tenant spc --model mpt-30b-v1.2-quant --policy canary:1%

Meeting notes (2026-02-19 call w/ SPC infra)
- SPC uses AWS account 111222333444 (they confirmed).
- They require all traffic egress through their firewall for audit - need to ensure egress IPs list for firewall allowlist. Ask infra for static NAT pool?
- Compliance: they want 90-day logs retention for audit. Redwood default is 30d for SE plan; need to scope retention add-on pricing.

Risks / Blockers
- Overlapping CIDR with SPC corp network (ask Ajay for topology) -> blocks peering.
- KMS key policy edits require SPC security approval (timeline unknown).
- Quant model quality risk: int8 may have slight regression on rare tokens; need to run eval set.

Next steps (my checklist)
- [ ] Create terraform VPC suggestion & CIDR map (Aisha) - due 2/24
- [ ] Run eval harness against mpt-30b-v1.2-quant on SPC prompts (Aisha) - due 2/28
- [ ] Draft KMS key policy template and push PR (Priya) - in progress
- [ ] Autoscale YAML draft + cost estimate (Tom) - requested by 3/3
- [ ] Draft rollout plan in Confluence and attach test prompts + regression criteria (team)

Notes to self:
- Keep communication thread short and action-focused; escalate to solutions lead if KMS approval > 5 business days.
- Add SPC contact info to ticket JIRA-SPC-88 and update to 'waiting on customer' where appropriate.

Related links
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-3421 (infra topology + rollout)
- Jira ticket: JIRA-SPC-88
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform-config/pull/412

End of scratchpad (save incremental updates here)
